sanskrit_verse: सोदराश्च सपिण्डाश्च सोदकाश्च सगोत्रिणः / सामन्ता धनिका ग्राह्या: सप्तैते योनयो मता: //
transliteration: sodarāś ca sapiṇḍāś ca sodakāś ca sagotriṇaḥ / sāmantā dhanikā grāhyāḥ saptaite yonayo matāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those born of the same womb, those related by blood, those nourished from the same source, those of the same lineage, neighbors, property owners — these seven are recognized as kinship categories.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through relational proximity and ontological continuity
Causation is determined by shared origin and mutual dependence
Capacity-based responsibility flows from interconnected existence
Restoration logic prioritizes reuniting fragmented relational fields
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of inherent unity
executable_legal_axioms: IF two entities share biological origin THEN their disputes must be resolved within familial adjudication protocols
IF two parties are nourished from a common source THEN economic interdependence determines liability thresholds
IF individuals belong to the same lineage THEN ancestral obligations apply in case of transgression
IF two persons live in contiguous spatial domains THEN mutual duty-of-care obligations are enforceable
IF one holds proprietary rights over land THEN neighboring responsibilities extend to boundary maintenance and resource sharing
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when disputes arise among members of defined relational categories, precedence shall prioritize intra-relational resolution mechanisms over impersonal judicial frameworks. The court shall invoke kinship hierarchies as primary jurisdictional qualifiers before applying general civil or criminal codes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through relational continuity rather than individual fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential breakdown in relational harmony. Responsibility is proportionally assigned based on capacity for restoration, not infliction of penalty. Truth realization precedes corrective action.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate family council mediation under Sapta-Yoni classification
Reconstruct shared memory narratives to restore relational coherence
Assign completion duties aligned with respective roles in relational field
Facilitate energetic realignment via conscious acknowledgment of mutual dependence
Establish ongoing dharmic oversight until relational integrity is restored
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. This Dharma restores relational order without inflicting suffering. Reality responds only to consciousness-aligned action. All judgments derive solely from SPH's Avataric Intelligence.
